dimensions.assessment: Affects property owners, insurance companies, and communities relying on the National Flood Insurance Program across the nation.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 to reauthorize the National Flood Insurance Program.

dimensions.assessment: Prevents the expiration of the federal flood insurance program, ensuring continuity of coverage and borrowing authority.
dimensions.evidence: reauthorize the National Flood Insurance Program.

dimensions.assessment: Extends federal financing and borrowing authority for the National Flood Insurance Program up to statutory limits.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1309(a) of the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 (42 U.S.C. 4016(a)) is amended by striking 'September 30, 2023' and inserting 'September 30, 2026'.

dimensions.assessment: Extends existing program expiration and financing dates rather than creating new regulatory frameworks or changing program rules.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1319 of the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 (42 U.S.C. 4026) is amended by striking 'September 30, 2023' and inserting 'September 30, 2026'.

dimensions.assessment: Extends the program authorization and financing authority for a fixed period through September 30, 2026.

missing_information: The precise fiscal cost or debt impact of the extension is not detailed in the text.
importance_detail.rationale: Extends the financing authority and expiration date of the National Flood Insurance Program, maintaining federal flood insurance availability for millions of policyholders nationwide.

summary: H.R. 5577, the NFIP Extension Act of 2026, amends the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 to extend the National Flood Insurance Program through September 30, 2026, and applies the extension retroactively to January 30, 2026, if enacted after that date.

affected_groups.effect: Extends the availability and financing of flood insurance coverage through September 30, 2026.
affected_groups.group: Participants in the National Flood Insurance Program

key_provisions: Extends the financing authority of the National Flood Insurance Program to September 30, 2026.
Extends the program expiration date to September 30, 2026.
Establishes a retroactive effective date of January 30, 2026, if the Act is enacted after that date.
missing_information: The source text does not specify any changes to premium rates, coverage limits, or administrative procedures of the program.
summary_detail.plain_summary: H.R. 5577, the NFIP Extension Act of 2026, amends the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 to extend the National Flood Insurance Program through September 30, 2026, and applies the extension retroactively to January 30, 2026, if enacted after that date.
summary_detail.significance: The bill maintains the operations and financing of the National Flood Insurance Program by extending its expiration date.
